### What Is the Password of e-Aadhaar?
![](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/static/media/ArrowDown.a5229ab197c918ede75c7ae811502301.svg)
Password of eAadhaar is a combination of the first 4 letters of name in CAPITAL and the year of birth (YYYY).  
  
**For Example:**
  * Example 1
    1. Name: SURESH KUMAR
    2. Year of Birth: 1990
    3. Password: SURE1990
  * Example 2
    1. Name: SAI KUMAR
    2. Year of Birth: 1990
    3. Password: SAIK1990
  * Example 3
    1. Name: P. KUMAR
    2. Year of Birth: 1990
    3. Password: P.KU1990
  * Example 4
    1. Name: RIA
    2. Year of Birth: 1990
    3. Password: RIA1990
